info.title: Volverán API
info.description:
The HTTP API of Volverán. `info.version` is the major version of the API, and through 1.x this API may only gain optional things. `/api`, where the API lived before 1.0, is an alias of `/api/v1` through 1.x, with the same routes, checks and answers.

In Team Mode every route needs a session: sign in at `/auth/login` and send its cookie. In Solo Mode there is no sign-in. A state-changing request with an `Origin` header must come from where the web app is reached (403 `foreign_origin`). With several Replicas, a request that another Replica must answer can get 503 `replica_unreachable`: try again.
